description:
## Problem
- ClickHouse ships no curated template, so `--tuning tuned` falls back to session SETs only. ClickHouse is the platform where catalog verification works.
- The fallback message "using basic constraints" (`benchbox/cli/tuning_resolver.py:454,459`) is wrong for Polars (streaming runtime) and ClickHouse (OLAP session pack).
- `tuning validate` and `tuning defaults` are DataFrame-only (`docs/reference/cli/tuning.md:68,135`), so SQL users cannot validate custom files.
- DataFrame `tuned` resolution waits on the D-8 decision.

## Change
- Add `examples/tunings/clickhouse/{tpch,ssb,tpcds}_tuned.yaml` plus packaged mirrors, with PK-prefix-consistent sort keys and partitions.
- Derive the fallback text from the registry per platform.
- Support SQL YAML in `tuning validate` via `validate_for_platform_detailed` and the registry.
- Implement the D-8 rule.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- A fallback never facet-matches a curated run (ADR-002).

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
